provenance.scope: PR4/PR4d epsilon 0 and 1 retain their accepted 20,000-digit numerical precision and independently accepted exact symbolic formulas. PR11d epsilon 0 for its three existing direct aliases has 20,000 validated digits and 20,008 stored digits from the sealed bounded transport proof. PR11d epsilon 1 and every other numerical coefficient remain unchanged; a finite period name does not promote symbolic exactness.

oracle_coverage_addendum.note: The frozen original oracle list checked 45 of 46 required integration anchors and the unused point 15/16. This additive correction independently checks K0/K1 at the missing actual shifted-interval center 1 (20,400 reference digits; 20,422 digits of agreement). Original rigorous Arb certificates, public coefficient bytes, and the 20,000-digit caps remain unchanged.

provenance.takeover_4L_closures_note: PR11d epsilon 0 of P17/P52/P74 keeps its bounded 20,000-digit numerical value; its row is now also exact (publication takeover-4L-closures-v1, formula cap 517 digits). Exactness comes from the publication receipt, never from the finite period name.
provenance.symbolic_expression_evaluation_note: Publication symbolic-expression-evaluation-v1 (base bf1d6e8e) replaces 644 numerical rows of 112 1L-4L masters by the values of their published exact formulas, evaluated at 20,100 and 20,200 working digits and kept only where more accurate than, and compatible with, the replaced value. Their errors are estimated (error_quality "estimated"), not interval bounds; formula rows cap at the validated digits of their finite constants. The scope statement above describes the Bessel and PR11d sources only. Exactness of these rows comes from their original publications; this receipt only binds their unchanged texts to the evaluated values.
provenance.takeover_basis_v4_rewrite_note: Publication takeover-basis-v4-rewrite-v1 (base f51bc5a2) restates every exact 1L-4L row in the 68-generator basis v4. Accepted symbolic sources, previous files and formula evaluations above still bind the pre-rewrite row texts, preserved byte-exactly as before-images; the rewrite receipt binds each current row text to its pre-rewrite text. No numerical value, digit count or error changes.
